ask.question: List the 20 most recent inventory movements with part, quantity and from / to location
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (20)
       d.TRNDTE AS movement_date,
       d.PRTNUM AS part,
       d.TRNQTY AS quantity,
       d.FRSTOL AS from_location,
       d.TOSTOL AS to_location
FROM dbo.dlytrn AS d
WHERE d.WH_ID = @wh_id
  AND d.PRTNUM IS NOT NULL
  AND d.FRSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.TOSTOL IS NOT NULL
  AND d.FRSTOL <> d.TOSTOL
ORDER BY d.TRNDTE DESC, d.DLYTRN_ID DESC;

ask.question: How many locations exist per area, and how many of them are empty?
ask.sql:
WITH occupied_locations AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        wh_id,
        stoloc
    FROM dbo.invlod
    WHERE wh_id = @wh_id
)
SELECT
    l.arecod AS area_code,
    COUNT(*) AS location_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.stoloc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_location_count
FROM dbo.locmst AS l
LEFT JOIN occupied_locations AS o
    ON o.wh_id = l.wh_id
   AND o.stoloc = l.stoloc
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY l.arecod
ORDER BY l.arecod;

ask.question: Inventory quantity per part and inventory status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    d.prtnum AS part_number,
    d.prt_client_id AS part_client_id,
    d.invsts AS inventory_status,
    SUM(CAST(d.untqty AS bigint)) AS inventory_quantity
FROM dbo.invdtl AS d
INNER JOIN dbo.invsub AS s
    ON s.subnum = d.subnum
INNER JOIN dbo.invlod AS l
    ON l.lodnum = s.lodnum
WHERE l.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id,
    d.invsts
ORDER BY
    d.prtnum,
    d.prt_client_id,
    d.invsts;

ask.question: How many unit loads are in each location zone?
ask.sql:
SELECT
    l.zoncod AS location_zone,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.unitld AS u
INNER JOIN live3.locatn AS l
    ON l.subsit = u.subsit
   AND l.locatn = u.locatn
GROUP BY l.zoncod
ORDER BY l.zoncod;

ask.question: Top 20 items by number of unit loads in stock
ask.sql:
SELECT TOP (20)
       ud.itmcls AS item_class,
       ud.itmcod AS item_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ul.ulid) AS unit_load_count
FROM live3.unitld AS ul
INNER JOIN live3.untdtl AS ud
    ON ud.ulid = ul.ulid
GROUP BY
       ud.itmcls,
       ud.itmcod
ORDER BY
       unit_load_count DESC,
       ud.itmcod ASC,
       ud.itmcls ASC;

ask.question: Total picked and shipped quantity per shipment status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    s.shpsts AS shipment_status,
    SUM(CAST(sl.pckqty AS bigint)) AS total_picked_quantity,
    SUM(CAST(sl.shpqty AS bigint)) AS total_shipped_quantity
FROM dbo.shipment AS s
INNER JOIN dbo.shipment_line AS sl
    ON sl.ship_id = s.ship_id
   AND sl.wh_id = s.wh_id
WHERE s.wh_id = @wh_id
  AND sl.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY s.shpsts
ORDER BY s.shpsts;

ask.question: Expected versus received quantity per receiving truck status
ask.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(t.rcvtrk_stat, '(blank)') AS receiving_truck_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.trknum) AS truck_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.expqty AS bigint)), 0) AS expected_quantity,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.rcvqty AS bigint)), 0) AS received_quantity,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.rcvqty AS bigint)), 0)
        - COALESCE(SUM(CAST(r.expqty AS bigint)), 0) AS quantity_variance
FROM dbo.rcvtrk AS t
LEFT JOIN dbo.rcvlin AS r
    ON r.trknum = t.trknum
   AND r.wh_id = t.wh_id
WHERE t.wh_id = @wh_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.rcvtrk_stat, '(blank)')
ORDER BY receiving_truck_status;
